note: Stage 1 finished ~14:30 MT (reported by Dave; tracker delivered nothing between mile 22.4 at 12:35 and the finish). Stage 2 started 15:41 MT, set manually so the rail runs before the first on-course fix arrives.

banner.message: Stage 1 done — heading out for stage 2. Tracking was patchy through stage 1: the satellite messenger lost most of its messages in the gulches, so the map has gaps that are not gaps in the ride. Trying a different mount position for stage 2 and hoping it comes through cleaner.
